panel.title: Track a repository
panel.body: Point at a GitHub repo and a path pattern, preview exactly which files match, then import them all into this project — kept tracked for a re-scan later.
panel.patternHelp: * matches within a folder, ** spans folders, ? one character — case-sensitive. Only .md, .mdx, and .html files import.
panel.patHint: Tracking a large public repo? Connect the workspace GitHub PAT in Settings for a higher rate limit — unauthenticated GitHub allows only 60 requests an hour.
panel.previewFailed: Something went wrong checking the repository. Please try again.
panel.confirmFailed: Something went wrong starting the scan. Please try again.

preview.zeroMatches: 0 files match this pattern. Adjust the pattern and preview again.
preview.matches: {count, plural, one {# file matches} other {# files match}}
preview.overlapTitle: Another tracked repo in this workspace already imports this path — importing here would duplicate it.
preview.confirmHint: Imports these files into the project and keeps the repo tracked.

row.scanFailedFallback: The scan failed. Check the repository details and try again.
row.removeHint: Its documents stay in the project — only tracking is removed.

report.filesUnchanged: · {count, plural, one {# file unchanged} other {# files unchanged}}
report.scanned: {count, plural, one {# file scanned} other {# files scanned}}
